themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Notifications sent by the app, including breaking-news alerts, the inability to find or change notification settings, and notifications that don't clear after opening an article.

themes.name: Live station streaming
themes.description: Whether live streams of local and member stations load and play, plus station search, nearest-station lookup, and stations or live-stream options that disappear.

themes.name: Playback reliability and buffering
themes.description: Audio that buffers, cuts out, skips, jumps or repeats, stops mid-story, or fails with errors such as 'unable to play this media'. Includes drops when switching networks or after interruptions such as calls and notification sounds.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Saving stories to a playlist or queue, including playlists that get erased, can't be found or reordered, and queue behavior such as skipping or starting mid-story when moving between items.

themes.name: App crashes and stability
themes.description: Force closes, freezes, apps that won't open or run, and breakage after Android or app updates or on specific devices.

themes.name: Battery and background activity
themes.description: The app running in the background when closed, draining battery, using data or memory, restarting or playing audio on its own after being closed, and permission concerns.

themes.name: Advertising
themes.description: Banner and pop-up ads, ads that can't be closed or cover article text, and ads or sponsor messages in audio.

themes.name: Interface design and navigation
themes.description: Visual design and layout, how outdated it looks, and ease of finding things. Includes requests for Material Design or a dark theme and the screen layout.

themes.name: Screen orientation support
themes.description: Lack of landscape or auto-rotate mode, especially on tablets and mounted devices, and requests to support it.

themes.name: Chromecast and device integration
themes.description: Requests for casting support and for integration with the lock screen, widget, SD card installation, Tasker, or Google TV.

themes.name: Political bias and trust
themes.description: Opinions on the fairness, bias, accuracy, and trustworthiness of NPR's journalism and coverage, whether praising it as unbiased or criticizing it as slanted.

themes.name: Content quality and programs
themes.description: Praise or comments about NPR's stories, shows, and podcasts, plus availability of specific programs and episodes and whether content is current or complete.

themes.name: Article reading experience
themes.description: Reading news text in the app, including images, tweets, and videos that fail to load, overlapping text, links, and missing features like comments or sharing.

themes.name: Offline listening and downloads
themes.description: Requests to download or cache audio and articles for offline use, and the lack of such features.
